# WaGo

> Agent-first WhatsApp API server in a single 21 MB Go binary. It links to a WhatsApp account as a linked device,
> keeps every message in a local SQLite mirror, and gives an AI agent one `turn.ready` event per turn and one call to
> reply, while it handles typing, read receipts, message bursts, voice-to-text, human takeover, a durable outbox and
> number-safety limits. WAHA-compatible REST, webhooks and WebSocket.

Start with AGENTS.md: it has the setup, the rules an agent must follow (sending is the owner's decision; test with
`-dev-fake` first), the reply contract and troubleshooting.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nik1t7n/wago/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guide for AI agents using or changing WaGo
- [Agent layer](https://github.com/nik1t7n/wago/blob/main/docs/AGENT-LAYER.md): turns, delivery, ownership, outbox, understanding, policy, replays
- [API reference](https://github.com/nik1t7n/wago/blob/main/docs/API.md): every route, event and error
- [Configuration](https://github.com/nik1t7n/wago/blob/main/docs/CONFIG.md): file, environment, flags, secrets
- [Example config](https://github.com/nik1t7n/wago/blob/main/wago.example.yaml): every field with its default
